name: J. Michael McKeldin
notable_stories: Described by his half-sister Barbara as too kind to tease her the way their brother Chuck did
He is the last living witness to his father Buckey McKeldin's household
Maintains a close relationship with Barbara, visiting her monthly in her later years
The youngest child of Buckey McKeldin and Peggy Quinn; he provides a crucial living link to the family's life on Nicklas Avenue in Baltimore
notes: Barbara identifies Mike as her brother.
Stayed home with Barbara’s mother while Barbara’s father drove Barbara to games and practices because the family had only one car.
Barbara says Mike either was too kind or learned from what she did to Chuck and did not call her Babs.
Brother of Barbara Jeanne Adams and Chuck McKeldin
Half-siblings: Barbara McKeldin Adams and Chuck McKeldin Jr. Also identified as Mike McKeldin.
